scripts.test: node scripts/check-test-discovery.mjs && vitest run && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/package-parity.test.mjs scripts/sign-mac.test.cjs scripts/verify-fuses.test.cjs scripts/smoke-packaged.test.mjs scripts/smoke-pins.test.mjs scripts/dev-app.test.mjs scripts/protocol-docs.test.mjs scripts/contract-parity.test.mjs scripts/renderer-lanes.test.mjs
scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:remote && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-main',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json
scripts.smoke:terminal: cargo build -p interface-host && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/smoke-integrated-terminal.mjs
scripts.smoke:remote: cargo build -p interface-host && npm run build:remote && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && electron scripts/smoke-remote.cjs
scripts.release:local: npm run package:smoke && npm run stage:update
scripts.release:local:replace: npm run package:smoke -- --allow-same-version && npm run stage:update -- --allow-same-version
